rows.what: Biome source member, assembly and shared settings/patch startup

rows.what: Volcanic ground, soil bands, lava pools/seams and cooled banks
rows.called_by: Biome terrain resolution; vanilla lava effects; cycle eligibility
rows.serves: Permanent habitable banks beside lethal melt
rows.why: Ordinary ground and routes are the land, not a secondary progression.

rows.what: Still heat, boiling rain, red fog, ash and ash-rain definitions
rows.called_by: RM_ForgePulse overrides weather; BiomeDef commonalities
rows.serves: The mountain closes its own boiling-water cycle
rows.why: Keep ordinary atmosphere. Ordinary rain in ash-rain and independent thermal effects must not bypass the cycle or Direct Sun.

rows.what: Recognisable surface foundry towers/remains shape ordinary resource routes
rows.called_by: Promised in biome description and later owner answer; no Forge placement/content row located in supplied src
rows.serves: An inhabited ruined forge rather than an unmarked volcano
rows.why: Required by the owner answer about ordinary journeys. Shared wreck machinery exists, but a generic wreck is not evidence of Forge-specific foundry towers.

rows.what: Ambient nonliving machinery moves beneath the melt without revealing its purpose
rows.called_by: Frozen sheet always-true/ban; historic campaign tower tender references only
rows.why: Keep the minimal visible, noninteractive background required by the frozen sheet. No quest, combat encounter or explanation follows from it; current surface implementation is unverified.

rows.what: Fire lavender, cinder crust and heatsink fungus have heat-tolerant flash growth; lavender glows
rows.called_by: Biome wildPlants; shared flash-window and growth engines
rows.serves: Life takes advantage of the wet interval
rows.why: Deleting flash response removes the biological half of the same rain cycle; ordinary tolerance and lavender glow remain plant identity. No room cooling is inferred.

rows.what: Firevine tree, heat tolerance, ordinary sowing and wood
rows.called_by: Biome wildPlants and vanilla plant jobs
rows.serves: Ordinary local tree and building supply
rows.why: An ordinary tree with vanilla harvest is life; no vent economy is admitted.

rows.what: Heatsink fungus description promises room cooling
rows.called_by: Description and study text; no cooling comp or exact-name cooling caller located across supplied src
rows.why: Recommend retiring the cooling promise: duplicates vanilla cooling and competes with learning ordinary shelter. The plant stays; uncertain cooling hooks must remain inactive pending decision.

rows.what: Fungus is patched as a source for deeper shade-cloth research
rows.called_by: CompProperties_FoundTechStudy on RM_HeatsinkFungus; vanilla study workgiver
rows.why: Neither ordinary fungus life nor the rain expedition needs a study job; disabling spunstone alone would miss this caller.

rows.what: Saved still/gas/rain/freeze/growth/cracks/melt phase clock
rows.called_by: Biome permanent RM_ForgePulse and shared weather pulse base class
rows.why: This clock is the single chain, not seven independent signatures.

rows.what: Warned gas wash ignites exposed flammable vegetation
rows.called_by: DoPhaseWork -> GasWashWave; fuel list and vanilla fire spread
rows.serves: Shelter before the rain and recoverable work windows
rows.why: Gas is the opening hazard in the ruled fire/water sequence; remove it and the stated signature loses its recall-before-fire step.

rows.what: Roof-sensitive boiling rain and short still-phase bursts use shared heat-armour damage
rows.called_by: EnterPhase -> ForceBurst; shared pulse damage loop and flash writes
rows.serves: Rain is dangerous but a first surprise is survivable
rows.why: Rain drives the crust/growth cycle. A weather picture with harmless rain would defeat that chain.

rows.what: FlowWorks water flood releases during rain
rows.called_by: Rain DoPhaseWork -> TryFloodRelease; Flood_FlowWorks.Configure
rows.why: Crusting and flash growth read phase/window, not flood extent. Deleting releases leaves the entire expedition chain intact.

rows.what: Temporary basalt/pumice on eligible LavaDeep
rows.called_by: FreezeBatch; pathfinding; gardens; crack/melt queues
rows.serves: Temporary access over previously lethal ground
rows.why: Temporary access is the opportunity; permanent ground alone cannot replace it.

rows.what: Cycle-seeded gardens mature on crust and can be harvested
rows.called_by: Growth -> SeedGardens; vanilla plant growth/harvest/haul
rows.serves: Reason to risk the temporary ground
rows.why: Without a usable harvest there is no expedition reward.

rows.what: Unharvested gardens leave with visible dust and counted drift message at cracks
rows.called_by: Cracks -> DriftOffGardens
rows.why: Removing the visible departure makes a lost harvest look like a bug; keep readable departure, not a new flying-garden entity.

rows.what: Cracks warn before owned crust returns to lava, damaging occupants and recording losses
rows.called_by: CrackBatch, MeltBatch and MeltCell; emergency/off cleanup
rows.serves: The expedition has a real deadline
rows.why: Removing returning lava makes temporary access permanent and defeats the signature.

rows.what: Phase/time inspect information, hiss/crack warnings and readable losses
rows.called_by: DoPhaseWork, EnterPhase, Description and melt summaries
rows.serves: Prompt recall and retreat using ordinary UI
rows.why: Without warning and deadline information attentive crews cannot make the owner-required recall/retreat decisions. Keep only actionable information, including silent-mode text.

rows.what: Arrival explanation of the cycle and shelter
rows.called_by: Shared arrival-letter engine reads biome extension
rows.serves: A newcomer understands the temporary ground
rows.why: The first hour needs a plain explanation of lethal rain and temporary ground; remove the false assertion that shade never works here. This necessary warning is the retained letter exception.

rows.what: Four phase voices, sustainers, stingers, glass notes and parallel prose cues
rows.called_by: Cycle voices.Tick and GasWashWave audio call
rows.why: Weather ambience and necessary written warnings already make the cycle readable; the separate orchestration is enrichment. Vanilla-audio waiver is respected.

rows.what: Rain/flash wakes wild dhokkur, julmox and resident dhuvvox; sealed pawns retain identity
rows.called_by: CompTick -> Check; vanilla CompCanBeDormant; dormant render worker
rows.serves: Animals visibly live by the same wet interval
rows.why: Deleting basic sealing/waking would remove the ruled between-rains life and its visible link to the same cycle. Faction-owned animals remain ordinary husbandry, never scheduled disappearance.

rows.what: Resident countdown, final slowing, click/scuttle schedule and curl cues
rows.called_by: ClockOn, UpdateSlowing, run-sound tick and CurlBack inside dormancy comp
rows.why: Basic dormant pose/wake already conveys interval life and phase UI supplies the deadline; a second clock is unnecessary.

rows.what: Additional rain-spawned dhuvvox and ash-trace destroy/reseal lifecycle
rows.called_by: EnterPhase Rain -> EruptSwarm; Freeze -> ResealSwarm; saved swarm list
rows.serves: Mass eruption beyond the resident population
rows.why: Residents already provide living interval fauna; injected mass population is an extra load and a separate disappearance lifecycle. Do not reopen the resident-pawn waiver.
